summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners filed an 8-K to provide unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025, following its merger with Synovus Financial Corp. completed on January 1, 2026. The filing does not announce a new special situation; it updates financial information related to a previously completed business combination. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are included. This is a routine current report updating pro forma financials, not a new special situation event.
